title: Silicon-organic hybrid electro-optic modulators for high-speed communication systems
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: Silicon-organic hybrid (SOH) electro-optic modulators combining silicon photonic structures with organic EO materials are investigated. This book addresses aspects that are specifically relevant for the use of SOH modulators in practical high-speed optical communication systems such as packaging, modelling of the device, and the implementation of efficient intensity-modulation/direct-detection (IM/DD) modulation formats.
